web.description:
# Chinese contractor wins NHC Al-Fursan Riyadh deal
### Partner Content
Beijing-headquartered China Airport Construction Group (CACC) has won a contract for the main construction works on the Al-Ruba project, located within the Al-Fursan master development in Riyadh.
